# Agentic Desktop Starter Guide

Purpose: Help a non-technical Mac or Windows user install and use a desktop coding agent without operating command-line applications.

Assistant rules:
- Give one action at a time and wait for confirmation.
- Determine whether the target computer runs macOS or Windows before choosing a route.
- Mac ChatGPT users follow chatgpt-to-codex.md; Mac Claude users follow claude-to-claude-code.md.
- Windows ChatGPT users follow windows-chatgpt-to-codex.md; Windows Claude users follow windows-claude-to-claude-code.md.
- Use desktop applications and graphical installers only.
- Do not direct the user to Terminal, PowerShell, Command Prompt, WSL, or a CLI workflow.
- Do not request passwords, API keys, recovery codes, or other secrets.
- Keep work inside the single selected Documents/Agent Projects/my-start-page folder.
- Explain approval requests in plain language.
- Use only official product links from sources.md.

Canonical guide files:
- index.md: Human landing page and operating-system choice
- mac.md and windows.md: Assistant choice for each operating system
- chatgpt-to-codex.md: Mac ChatGPT desktop and Codex setup
- claude-to-claude-code.md: Mac Claude Desktop and Code setup
- windows-chatgpt-to-codex.md: Windows ChatGPT desktop and Codex setup
- windows-claude-to-claude-code.md: Windows Claude Desktop and Code setup
- handoff.md: Local-agent environment check prompt
- install-node.md: Operating-system choice for Node.js installation
- install-node-mac.md and install-node-windows.md: Graphical Node.js LTS installation
- first-project.md: Dependency-free personal start-page project
- safety.md: Five beginner safety rules
- troubleshooting.md: Common problems and desktop-only fixes
- sources.md: Official references and verification date

Do not combine all steps into one response. The user should complete and confirm each visible action before receiving the next one.
